title: 42. The ſacraments be no ſacraments without the vſe of them.

segments.text: FOr as muche as this mutation or chaunge is onely in the vſe thereof it foloweth alſo that before, or after thadminiſtratiō of the ſacraments it taketh no place, but onely during the action & the vſe to the which this chaunge or mutation tendeth.
